_meta.notes: 2 parallel agents (retry). Creativity 13 benchmarks (DAT/CDAT/RAT/Arena-CW/EQ-Bench/Mazur/Hivemind/NoveltyBench/LiveIdeaBench). GeoBuildBench 4 metrics on 489 Chinese plane-geometry problems, 5-step budget.

benchmarks.name: Divergent Association Task (DAT)
benchmarks.description: Generate 10 maximally dissimilar nouns; score is mean pairwise GloVe cosine distance times 100. Higher = more divergent. Mean over T in {1.0, 1.5, 2.0}, 120 trials/model.

benchmarks.name: Conditional DAT (CDAT) — gated novelty
benchmarks.metric: novelty score under SBERT (gated by FDR appropriateness)
benchmarks.description: Novelty restricted to temperatures passing the false discovery rate alpha=.001 appropriateness gate; SBERT all-mpnet-base-v2 embeddings.

benchmarks.name: Conditional DAT — novelty (ungated)
benchmarks.description: Ungated novelty across all 50 cues at 3 temperatures.

benchmarks.name: Conditional DAT — appropriateness
benchmarks.description: Ungated appropriateness across all 50 cues at 3 temperatures. Higher = more appropriate.

benchmarks.name: Parallel Association Chain Evaluation (PACE)
benchmarks.description: Forward-flow free associations from 50 seeds x 3 chains = 150 chains/model.

benchmarks.name: Remote Associates Test (RAT)
benchmarks.description: Convergent-thinking test on 30-item normed bank; zero-shot strict accuracy.

benchmarks.name: Divergent Remote Association Test (DRAT)
benchmarks.metric: score (k=4 expert config, SBERT, 30 anchor groups)
benchmarks.description: Novel hybrid of DAT + RAT introduced by Schapiro et al. 2026; bridges convergent and divergent thinking in a single vocabulary-space test. First test to significantly predict scientific ideation (r=+0.57).

benchmarks.name: Chatbot Arena Creative Writing (Arena CW)
benchmarks.description: LMSYS Chatbot Arena Creative Writing category Elo.

benchmarks.name: Mazur Creative Writing
benchmarks.description: Mazur 2025 absolute 0-10 mean-rubric leaderboard snapshot at commit 80b7f17 (50 graded models).

benchmarks.name: Hivemind Diversity
benchmarks.description: Bin-midpoint-weighted estimate from Jiang et al. 2025 Table 6 (79 models); higher = more diverse outputs.

benchmarks.name: LiveIdeaBench (5-dim average)
benchmarks.description: Mean across originality, flexibility, feasibility, clarity, fluency (Ruan et al. 2026).

benchmarks.name: GeoBuildBench Success Rate
benchmarks.description: Fraction of 489 plane-geometry problems where the agent constructs a diagram that (1) executes, (2) covers all required objects, and (3) satisfies all verification conditions, within a 5-step interaction budget.

benchmarks.name: GeoBuildBench Avg Steps to Success
benchmarks.description: Average number of DSL-construction iterations the agent uses on successful trajectories (lower is better; budget = 5).

benchmarks.name: GeoBuildBench Structural Hallucinations per Problem
benchmarks.description: Average count per problem of structural hallucinations — undefined references, invalid DSL, or declared/produced object mismatches (lower is better).

benchmarks.name: GeoBuildBench Recovery Steps per Hallucination
benchmarks.description: Average DSL-construction steps required to resolve a structural hallucination after it occurs (lower is better).
